notes: 静态向量；本轮不执行。安装类向量必须使用 npm（不是 bun install -g），并在一次性 CI 容器/临时 prefix 中运行；不写真实凭据。

vectors.title: 两变体的 license/文件映射与 tarball 后缀单测通过
no-webui 变体：npm 安装后 MIT、无 NOTICE、health 正常
vectors.command:
set -euo pipefail
version="<version>"
platform="<platform>"
port="${PORT:?set PORT to a free local port}"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'npm uninstall -g @coding-chimera/chimera >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
npm install -g "./dist/npm-tarballs/coding-chimera-chimera-${platform}-no-webui-${version}.tgz" "./dist/npm-tarballs/coding-chimera-chimera-no-webui-${version}.tgz"
command -v chimera
chimera --version
pkg="$(npm root -g)/@coding-chimera/chimera/package.json"
node -e 'const p=require(process.argv[1]); if(p.license!=="MIT") process.exit(1); console.log("license="+p.license)' "$pkg"
test ! -e "$(npm root -g)/@coding-chimera/chimera/NOTICE"
chimera serve --port "$port" --hostname localhost >"$tmp/out" 2>"$tmp/err" &
pid=$!
for i in $(seq 1 50); do if curl -fsS "http://localhost:$port/global/health" >"$tmp/health" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep 0.2; done
grep -q '"healthy":true' "$tmp/health"
kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'license=MIT health=ok\n'
vectors.cleanup: trap 卸载全局包并删除临时目录
vectors.notes: 需要先按 build.ts --no-webui 构建出 tarball；本目录不代为构建。

vectors.title: with-webui 变体：npm 安装后 GPL-3.0-only、NOTICE 存在、根路径不是 missing-assets
vectors.command:
set -euo pipefail
version="<version>"
platform="<platform>"
port="${PORT:?set PORT to a free local port}"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'npm uninstall -g @coding-chimera/chimera >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
npm install -g "./dist/npm-tarballs/coding-chimera-chimera-${platform}-with-webui-${version}.tgz" "./dist/npm-tarballs/coding-chimera-chimera-with-webui-${version}.tgz"
command -v chimera
chimera --version
pkg="$(npm root -g)/@coding-chimera/chimera/package.json"
node -e 'const p=require(process.argv[1]); if(p.license!=="GPL-3.0-only") process.exit(1); console.log("license="+p.license)' "$pkg"
test -e "$(npm root -g)/@coding-chimera/chimera/NOTICE"
export OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD="$(node -e 'console.log(require("crypto").randomBytes(16).toString("hex"))')"
chimera web --open=false --port "$port" --hostname localhost >"$tmp/out" 2>"$tmp/err" &
pid=$!
for i in $(seq 1 50); do if curl -fsS -u "chimera:${OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD}" "http://localhost:$port/" >"$tmp/root.html" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep 0.2; done
if grep -q "not embedded in this build" "$tmp/root.html"; then echo "missing webui assets"; exit 1; fi
kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'license=GPL-3.0-only webui=ok\n'
vectors.cleanup: trap 卸载全局包、清理临时目录；不保留密码
vectors.notes: 需要先按 build.ts --with-webui 构建出 tarball；密码由 node crypto 现场生成，不落盘。

vectors.title: 当前安装包内不存在 host 二进制，CLI 仍可运行（legacy）
vectors.command:
set -euo pipefail
platform="<platform>"
pkg_root="$(npm root -g)/@coding-chimera/chimera"
platform_pkg_root="$(npm root -g)/@coding-chimera/chimera-${platform}"
test -d "$platform_pkg_root"
test ! -e "$pkg_root/bin/host/chimera-host"
test ! -e "$platform_pkg_root/bin/host/chimera-host"
command -v chimera
chimera --version
printf 'host_binary=absent cli=ok\n'
vectors.notes: 需要先安装任一变体（含对应平台包）；同时检查主包与平台包 @coding-chimera/chimera-<platform> 均无 bin/host/chimera-host。
